verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs link directly to a downloadable OpenAPI specification at /openapi.json. A hands-on probe confirmed that URL returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key, so the spec is real and machine-readable. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the spec's scope, versioning or completeness (the docs offer only a single download link).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developer.sumup.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
